item.title: Call for new ActiveMQ project logo
item.dc:creator: Apache ActiveMQ
item.description: The Apache ActiveMQ logo was created a few years ago. While the project continues to evolve, the logo needs to be updated to reflect current ActiveMQ technology. So, the PMC has discussed making a “Call For Entry” where you can submit a new ActiveMQ Logo.
item.content:encoded:
Organization: Apache ActiveMQ

Status: filled

Compensation: gratis

Role: Logo re-design

The Apache ActiveMQ logo was created a few years ago. While the project continues to evolve, the logo needs to be updated to reflect current ActiveMQ technology. So, the PMC has discussed making a “Call For Entry” where you can submit a new ActiveMQ Logo.

How to Apply:

  • dev@activemq.apache.org
  • https://blogs.apache.org/activemq/entry/apache-activemq-call-for-logo

Read more on opensourcedesign.net →
